unselectedGenerations.prompt: Generate a single complete character walking pose as the in-between between reference image 1 (frame 01, earlier) and reference image 2 (frame 02, later). Preserve the same small stylized adventurer, back/upper-left-facing view, orange tousled hair, blue hood and cape, blue tunic, brown gloves, shorts, boots, colors, linework and proportions. Keep the head, torso, pelvis/root, arms and cape in a calm halfway transition between the two references, with stable body scale and consistent shoe-toe direction. The key action: the screen-left boot is lowering toward contact but is still clearly a little above the ground, halfway between its lifted position in reference 1 and planted position in reference 2; show a readable near-contact transition, sole roughly 8 pixels above the planted right/supporting boot. Keep the screen-right/support boot planted and bearing weight. Draw the whole body as one coherent pose; do not isolate, shift, rotate, or transform only a shoe or limb. One character centered in a square frame, entire silhouette visible, transparent background, clean polished hand-painted game sprite, crisp dark outlines, no ground shadow, no extra objects, no labels or text.
